title: Hearing in San Juan that Hello Dolly was charting
summary: The band had forgotten the tune until Glaser's office called in San Juan, Puerto Rico, saying it was in the top five; the transcript ends abruptly.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: So we went on tour the next day, and forgot about "Hello Dolly". This boy Bob had lost the music; he was supposed to be the band boy. And it was all forgotten until we wound up in San Juan, Puerto Rico, around Christmas. We opened in San Juan, Puerto Rico. We were supposed to be there nine days I believe at the Hotel El San Juan.
Oh, I've played there, yes. A big old place...
An old-fashioned place from the Thirties.

And he got a call from the office... Joe Glaser's office called. Ira, Ira Mangel(?) I think was the manager of the band. Frenchy had gone. Joe Glaser says to start playing "Hello Dolly" because it's making the charts. I think it had got to number four or five on the charts.
Were you surprised it got that high?
I didn't know one way or another! I says, "'Hello Dolly'?!" I had forgot about the tune completely...
